prompt: Edit this finished coloured manga medallion ONLY to repair its background opacity. Preserve the character face, pose, costume, colours, ink drawing, crop and thin gold circular rim exactly. Fully opaque output PNG everywhere, no alpha transparency, no transparent holes. Same square composition and native resolution. NO text, letters, numbers, new objects, scenery or watermark.
